changeSet.author: grushton
changeSet.sql: LOCK TABLE dataset IN SHARE ROW EXCLUSIVE MODE

INSERT INTO asset_catalog (asset_type, asset_number, dataset_id, source_dataset_id, backfill_run) SELECT 'DATASET', d.alias::integer, d.dataset_id, d.dataset_id, 'changelog-consent-2026-11-03-asset-catalog-dataset-backfill' FROM dataset d WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM asset_catalog c WHERE c.dataset_id = d.dataset_id) ON CONFLICT (asset_type, asset_number) DO NOTHING

SELECT setval('dataset_alias_seq', top.n::bigint) FROM ( SELECT GREATEST( (SELECT MAX(alias) FROM dataset), (SELECT MAX(asset_number) FROM asset_catalog WHERE asset_type = 'DATASET')) AS n ) top, dataset_alias_seq s WHERE top.n >= (CASE WHEN s.is_called THEN s.last_value + 1 ELSE s.last_value END)

rollback.sql: DELETE FROM asset_catalog WHERE backfill_run = 'changelog-consent-2026-11-03-asset-catalog-dataset-backfill' AND dataset_id IS NOT NULL AND asset_removed_date IS NULL
